description: Lists the presentation's theme building blocks: layouts[] (objectId, name like TITLE_AND_BODY, displayName, masterObjectId), masters[] and the notesMasterObjectId. Layout object ids feed add_slide's layout_object_id; the Slides API cannot import a new theme or change the master set — themes are chosen in the UI, this tool only reads what the deck already has.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: list_layouts
title: List layouts and masters
